sentences.en: The play ended to thunderous ______ from the sold-out theater.
sentences.zh: 這齣戲在座無虛席的劇院裡,以如雷的掌聲畫下句點。

sentences.en: A brief silence preceded the ______ , as if the audience needed a moment to recover.
sentences.zh: 掌聲響起前有短暫的沉默,彷彿觀眾需要一點時間才能回過神來。

words.defn_en: relevant or appropriate to a particular situation:

sentences.en: The new safety rules are ______ to all factory employees, not just new hires.
sentences.zh: 這項新的安全規定適用於所有工廠員工,而不僅限於新進人員。

sentences.en: Her research findings are ______ well beyond the field of biology.
sentences.zh: 她的研究結果的適用範圍遠遠超出生物學領域。

words.defn_en: a person who is appointed to a position:

sentences.en: The president's latest ______ faces a difficult confirmation hearing.
sentences.zh: 總統最新任命的官員即將面臨一場艱難的確認聽證會。

sentences.en: As a political ______ , she served only as long as the administration remained in power.
sentences.zh: 身為政治任命的官員,她的任期僅限於該政府執政期間。

sentences.en: Her ______ comparison made the complex policy easy to understand.
sentences.zh: 她貼切的比喻,讓這項複雜的政策變得容易理解。

sentences.en: The professor praised the student's ______ use of the quotation.
sentences.zh: 教授讚賞這位學生恰當地運用了這句引言。

words.defn_en: to assess the worth or value of:

sentences.en: A professional was hired to ______ the antique furniture before the auction.
sentences.zh: 這場拍賣會前,他們聘請了一位專業人士來鑑定這件古董家具。

sentences.en: The bank sent an inspector to ______ the value of the house.
sentences.zh: 銀行派了一名檢查員來評估這棟房子的價值。

sentences.en: Police managed to ______ the suspect just blocks from the crime scene.
sentences.zh: 警方成功在距離犯罪現場僅幾條街的地方逮捕了嫌犯。

sentences.en: It took him a while to fully ______ the complexity of the situation.
sentences.zh: 他花了一段時間才完全理解這個情況的複雜性。

words.defn_en: anxiety about the future; understanding; the act of arresting:

sentences.en: She felt a growing sense of ______ as the interview date approached.
sentences.zh: 隨著面試日期逼近,她內心的憂慮感也越來越強烈。

sentences.en: The suspect's ______ came after months of careful police investigation.
sentences.zh: 在警方數月的縝密調查後,嫌犯終於被逮捕。

words.defn_en: anxious or fearful about something that may happen:

sentences.en: He felt ______ about presenting in front of the entire board.
sentences.zh: 在整個董事會面前簡報,讓他感到十分緊張。

sentences.en: Parents were ______ about sending their kids back to school after the outbreak.
sentences.zh: 疫情爆發後,家長對送孩子回學校感到憂心忡忡。

sentences.en: The young painter sought her mentor's ______ for every new piece.
sentences.zh: 這位年輕畫家每完成一幅新作品,都渴望得到導師的讚許。

sentences.en: The proposal received the committee's full ______ without a single objection.
sentences.zh: 這項提案獲得委員會全體一致的讚同,沒有任何異議。

sentences.en: Lily's velvet dress was ______ for the formal occasion.
sentences.zh: 莉莉的絲絨洋裝很適合這個正式場合。

sentences.en: It would not be ______ to discuss salaries in front of clients.
sentences.zh: 在客戶面前談論薪資並不恰當。

words.defn_en: to officially agree to or accept as satisfactory:

sentences.en: The committee voted to ______ the budget for next year.
sentences.zh: 委員會投票通過了明年的預算案。

sentences.en: Her parents did not ______ of her decision to travel alone.
sentences.zh: 她的父母不贊同她獨自旅行的決定。

words.defn_en: close to the actual, but not completely accurate or exact:

sentences.en: The ______ distance between the two cities is 200 miles.
sentences.zh: 這兩座城市之間的大約距離是兩百英里。

sentences.en: The ______ cost is $50, though the final price may vary.
sentences.zh: 大概的費用是五十美元,不過最終價格可能會有所不同。

sentences.en: The committee acted as the final ______ in the dispute.
sentences.zh: 這個委員會在這場爭議中扮演最終仲裁者的角色。

sentences.en: Critics are often seen as the ______s of good taste in fashion.
sentences.zh: 評論家常被視為時尚品味的權威裁定者。

sentences.en: The store displayed a colorful ______ of fresh vegetables.
sentences.zh: 這家商店展示了一整排色彩繽紛的新鮮蔬菜。

sentences.en: The gala featured an impressive ______ of celebrities.
sentences.zh: 這場盛會集結了眾多令人驚豔的名人。

words.defn_en: an exaggerated sense of one's own importance:

sentences.en: His ______ alienated even his most loyal supporters.
sentences.zh: 他的傲慢連最忠實的支持者都感到疏離。

sentences.en: The champion's quiet confidence never crossed into ______.
sentences.zh: 這位冠軍不動聲色的自信,從未演變成傲慢。

sentences.en: His ______ attitude made it hard for teammates to work with him.
sentences.zh: 他傲慢的態度讓隊友很難跟他合作。

sentences.en: She refused to apologize, appearing ______ even after her mistake was pointed out.
sentences.zh: 即使錯誤已被指出,她依然拒絕道歉,態度顯得十分傲慢。

sentences.en: The general tried to ______ powers that belonged only to the president.
sentences.zh: 這位將軍試圖僭越,擅自取得只屬於總統的權力。

sentences.en: He was criticized for trying to ______ credit for his team's hard work.
sentences.zh: 他因試圖將團隊的辛勞成果據為己有而受到批評。

sentences.en: The hikers began to ______ the steep mountain trail at sunrise.
sentences.zh: 登山者在日出時開始攀登這條陡峭的山徑。

sentences.en: The elevator will ______ to the top floor in less than a minute.
sentences.zh: 這部電梯將在不到一分鐘內上升到頂樓。

sentences.en: The detective worked to ______ the exact time of the crime.
sentences.zh: 這名偵探努力查明犯罪發生的確切時間。

sentences.en: Doctors ran several tests to ______ the cause of her symptoms.
sentences.zh: 醫生進行了多項檢驗,以查明她這些症狀的成因。

sentences.en: Scientists ______ the rise in temperature to human activity.
sentences.zh: 科學家將氣溫上升歸因於人類活動。

sentences.en: She ______s her success to years of discipline and hard work.
sentences.zh: 她將自己的成功歸功於多年的自律與努力。

sentences.en: The senator refused to cast ______s on his opponent's character.
sentences.zh: 這位參議員拒絕對他對手的人格做出誹謗中傷。

sentences.en: She felt hurt by the unfair ______s made against her reputation.
sentences.zh: 她對於這些對她名譽不公正的中傷感到十分受傷。

sentences.en: Every ______ for the position had to submit a detailed résumé.
sentences.zh: 每一位這個職位的有志應徵者都必須提交詳細的履歷。

sentences.en: The young ______ practiced piano for six hours a day to prepare for the competition.
sentences.zh: 這位年輕的有志參賽者每天練習六小時鋼琴以準備比賽。

sentences.en: Many young athletes ______ to compete in the Olympics one day.
sentences.zh: 許多年輕運動員都渴望有朝一日能參加奧運。

sentences.en: She has always ______ to become a published author.
sentences.zh: 她一直立志成為一名出版作家。

sentences.en: Critics continued to ______ the government's new policy.
sentences.zh: 評論家持續抨擊政府的這項新政策。

sentences.en: Doubts began to ______ her confidence just before the performance.
sentences.zh: 就在表演即將開始之前,疑慮開始侵襲她的信心。

words.defn_en: a person who physically attacks another:

sentences.en: Police released a sketch of the ______ based on witness descriptions.
sentences.zh: 警方根據目擊者的描述,發布了施暴者的素描。

sentences.en: The victim managed to fight off her ______ and escape.
sentences.zh: 受害者成功擊退攻擊者並逃脫。

words.defn_en: a physical attack; to attack violently:

sentences.en: He was charged with ______ after the bar fight.
sentences.zh: 酒吧鬥毆事件後,他被控傷害罪。

sentences.en: Enemy forces prepared to ______ the fortress at dawn.
sentences.zh: 敵軍準備在黎明時分攻打這座堡壘。

sentences.en: We need to ______ the bed if we want a place to sleep tonight.
sentences.zh: 如果我們今晚想有地方睡覺,就得把這張床組裝起來。

sentences.en: Hundreds of protesters began to ______ outside the city hall.
sentences.zh: 數百名抗議者開始聚集在市政廳外。

sentences.en: The board gave its ______ to the merger after weeks of debate.
sentences.zh: 經過數週的討論,董事會終於同意了這項合併案。

sentences.en: She reluctantly ______ to her brother's plan.
sentences.zh: 她勉強同意了哥哥的計畫。

words.defn_en: to state or declare something confidently or forcefully:

sentences.en: He ______ his innocence in the face of the accusations.
sentences.zh: 面對這些指控,他堅稱自己是清白的。

sentences.en: She continued to ______ that the company had treated her unfairly.
sentences.zh: 她持續主張這家公司對她的待遇並不公平。

sentences.en: Teachers use quizzes to ______ students' understanding of the material.
sentences.zh: 老師利用小考來評估學生對教材的理解程度。

sentences.en: The insurance company sent an agent to ______ the damage to the house.
sentences.zh: 保險公司派了一名理賠專員來評估這棟房子的損害情況。

sentences.en: Her fluency in three languages is a great ______ in international business.
sentences.zh: 她精通三種語言,是她在國際商務上的一大資產。

sentences.en: The company's most valuable ______ is its loyal customer base.
sentences.zh: 這家公司最寶貴的資產就是它忠誠的顧客群。

words.defn_en: to state something firmly and seriously:

sentences.en: The witness continued to ______ her innocence despite the harsh questioning.
sentences.zh: 儘管遭到嚴厲的質問,證人仍持續堅稱自己是清白的。

sentences.en: He would ______ , again and again, that he had never signed the document.
sentences.zh: 他一再鄭重聲明,自己從未在那份文件上簽名。

sentences.en: Her ______ study habits helped her earn top marks in every subject.
sentences.zh: 她刻苦勤勉的學習習慣讓她在每一科都拿到最高分。

sentences.en: The ______ nurse checked on her patients every hour throughout the night.
sentences.zh: 這位盡職勤奮的護士整夜每小時都去查看她的病人。

words.defn_en: to absorb and integrate into a larger group or system:

sentences.en: Immigrants often ______ new customs while keeping parts of their own culture.
sentences.zh: 移民常會吸收新的習俗,同時保留部分自己的文化。

sentences.en: The body needs vitamin D to properly ______ calcium.
sentences.zh: 人體需要維生素D才能正常吸收鈣質。

words.defn_en: the repetition of vowel sounds in nearby words:

sentences.en: The line "hear the mellow wedding bells" uses ______ with its repeated "e" sounds.
sentences.zh: 「hear the mellow wedding bells」這句運用重複的「e」母音,構成了母音韻。

sentences.en: Poets often rely on ______ instead of exact rhyme for a subtler musical effect.
sentences.zh: 詩人常運用母音韻而非完全押韻,以營造更細膩的音樂效果。

words.defn_en: to alleviate; to lessen pain or conflict; pacify

sentences.en: The doctor's reassurance helped ______ her fears about the surgery.
sentences.zh: 醫生的安慰有助於緩解她對手術的恐懼。

sentences.en: Nothing could ______ his guilt over the accident.
sentences.zh: 沒有任何事能減輕他對這場意外的愧疚感。

words.defn_en: to suppose something to be true without proof; to take on a role:

sentences.en: Don't ______ the meeting is canceled just because no one has confirmed it.
sentences.zh: 別因為沒人確認,就假設會議取消了。

sentences.en: She will ______ the role of director starting next month.
sentences.zh: 她將於下個月開始接任導演一職。

words.defn_en: a thing accepted as true without proof:

sentences.en: The report was based on a faulty ______ about consumer demand.
sentences.zh: 這份報告是建立在一個對消費者需求的錯誤假設之上。

sentences.en: It's a common ______ that older employees resist new technology, but data suggests otherwise.
sentences.zh: 許多人普遍假設年長員工抗拒新科技,但數據顯示並非如此。

words.defn_en: sharply harsh or biting in tone; a substance that contracts body tissue:

sentences.en: Her ______ review left no doubt about what she thought of the restaurant.
sentences.zh: 她尖刻的評論,讓人一看就知道她對這家餐廳的看法。

sentences.en: The dermatologist recommended a mild ______ to help close the pores.
sentences.zh: 皮膚科醫師建議使用溫和的收斂劑,以幫助收縮毛孔。

sentences.en: It took years of practice for her to ______ such a high level of skill.
sentences.zh: 她花了多年的練習才達到如此高超的技術水準。

sentences.en: The company hopes to ______ record profits by the end of the year.
sentences.zh: 這家公司希望在年底前達成創紀錄的利潤。

words.defn_en: notice taken of someone or something; careful thought or consideration:

sentences.en: The teacher demanded everyone's full ______ before continuing the lesson.
sentences.zh: 老師要求大家全神貫注,才願意繼續上課。

sentences.en: Her research finally received the ______ it deserved after years of being overlooked.
sentences.zh: 在被忽視多年後,她的研究終於得到了應有的關注。

sentences.en: The signal became ______ as it traveled through the thick walls.
sentences.zh: 訊號在穿過厚牆時逐漸減弱。

sentences.en: Her fear gradually ______ as she grew more confident on stage.
sentences.zh: 隨著她在台上愈發自信,她的恐懼逐漸減弱。

sentences.en: Several employees can ______ to his honesty and hard work.
sentences.zh: 幾位員工都能證明他的誠實與努力。

sentences.en: The document was signed by a notary to ______ its authenticity.
sentences.zh: 這份文件由公證人簽署以證實其真實性。

sentences.en: Historians ______ the painting to a lesser-known Renaissance artist.
sentences.zh: 歷史學家將這幅畫歸屬於一位較不知名的文藝復興時期藝術家。

sentences.en: She ______s her calm demeanor to years of meditation practice.
sentences.zh: 她將自己沉著的性格歸功於多年的冥想練習。

sentences.en: The knight vowed to ______ his fallen brother.
sentences.zh: 這位騎士發誓要為他倒下的兄弟報仇。

sentences.en: The film follows a warrior seeking to ______ his village's destruction.
sentences.zh: 這部電影描述一位戰士試圖為家鄉村莊的毀滅復仇。

sentences.en: The parade marched down the city's main ______.
sentences.zh: 這場遊行隊伍沿著這座城市的主要大道前進。

sentences.en: Networking can open up new ______s for career growth.
sentences.zh: 建立人脈可以為職涯發展開啟新的途徑。

words.defn_en: to state something as a fact with confidence:

sentences.en: The witness continued to ______ that she had seen nothing unusual that night.
sentences.zh: 證人持續斷言她那晚沒看到任何異常的事。

sentences.en: He ______ that the new policy would save the company millions.
sentences.zh: 他斷言這項新政策能為公司省下數百萬。

sentences.en: He publicly ______ his support for the reform, despite the backlash it caused.
sentences.zh: 儘管引發了反彈,他仍公開表明支持這項改革。

sentences.en: She would ______ her loyalty to the cause until her final days.
sentences.zh: 直到生命最後一刻,她都堅定表明對這項理念的忠誠。

sentences.en: His sudden ______ of guilt surprised everyone in the courtroom.
sentences.zh: 他突然坦承有罪,讓法庭上所有人都感到意外。

sentences.en: Her ______ of love came only after years of hesitation.
sentences.zh: 她坦承愛意,是在猶豫了多年之後才說出口的。

sentences.en: The mistake in the report was completely ______, not an attempt to deceive anyone.
sentences.zh: 報告中的錯誤完全是無意的,並非想欺騙任何人。

sentences.en: Her ______ comment about the surprise party ruined the secret.
sentences.zh: 她無意間提到驚喜派對的話,毀了這個秘密。
